chain.title: Standing Orders
chain.desc: Craft from iron, an ME Interface, a Crafting Co-Processing Unit, an Engineering Processor, copper and an amethyst shard; it holds a shopping list and keeps every line item stocked by autocrafting.

chain.title: The Requests Desk
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from an illuminated panel, a Logic Processor and an ME Requester; the terminal edits every Requester on the network from one screen.

notes: Genuinely a two-item mod: the jar registers only merequester:requester and merequester:requester_terminal, so this is the complete honest chain and nothing was padded. Its 1.58M downloads reflect popularity as a single quality-of-life block, not breadth. ASSUMES FROM PARENT (ae2): ME Interface, Crafting Co-Processing Unit, Engineering Processor, Logic Processor, an illuminated panel (ae2:illuminated_panel tag), and a working autocrafting setup - the Requester does nothing without patterns for it to pull on. VERIFICATION: strict model/lang intersection, 2/2 matched, no widening needed, no drops.
